about: X-468 — assertions written for a real incident. test/test_pinned.js fails when one disappears, is renamed or its statement changes. Removing or loosening one needs the user's yes, asked in chat (_REF/test-discipline.md, docs/CONVENTIONS.md "Incident guards are pinned"). A refactor that keeps a guard exactly as strict updates its hash and names it under "Pins changed:" in the commit body.
